title: My Stepson Forged Title, Sold My $112K Airstream Fleet, Sent Me $3,900. So I Voided The Sale
description: After twenty-seven years as a school custodian, I used my late husband's $112,000 life insurance to restore vintage Airstreams with my stepson. He forged a title transfer, sold the fleet for $620,000, and mailed me a $3,900 propane check, so I pulled the original notarized partnership paperwork from a 1958 Overlander's propane locker and voided the sale. Now he reseams trailer cushions in coveralls that say Riveted by Lies while every booking prints his fraud docket number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #Glamping
thumb_text: HE FORGED THE TITLE, I VOIDED THE SALE
pinned_comment: If your stepson forged a title transfer and sent you a $3,900 propane check for a $620,000 sale after you cashed out your late husband's $112,000 policy, what would you have done? Tell me your story in the comments.
